name: Do I need to seal natural stone flooring after installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to seal natural stone flooring after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, sealing is typically recommended for most natural stone flooring types after installation. Sealers penetrate the stone to protect it from water absorption, staining, and etching from spills. While some dense stones like granite may be less porous, most marbles, travertines, and limestones benefit significantly from sealing. The frequency of re-sealing depends on the stone type, foot traffic, and the specific sealer used, usually every 1-3 years.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, sealing is generally recommended for natural stone floors post-installation to protect against stains and moisture. Re-seal periodically.
